correctness.rationale: Every binary palindrome factor of an exactly five-run binary word has 1, 3, or 5 runs; the classified types and intersection corrections yield the exact defect formula. Independent full palindrome-center enumeration checked 3,125 positive five-tuples, and all coefficient/moment histogram identities through length 26. Product generating functions and singularity analysis prove all-integer enumerative and limiting claims. The sharp length cutoff and maximum have explicit witnesses.

value.rationale: Five runs form the smallest binary alternating-run family admitting positive palindromic defect, making the family a structurally motivated threshold. The theorem gives every defect value and complete joint length/defect generating function, a sharp maximum cutoff, a nontrivial asymptotic positive-defect density 1/3, and a linear mean n/30. These are informative quantitative invariants not obtained from a simple binary-richness yes/no test.
